name: Community — Song + Album Art
author: m-a-p (YuE2) + MiniMax (Music 3) + Alibaba Qwen (Qwen-Image 2.1)
description:
Model format: int8 ConvRot (YuE2 or Music 3 for the song, Qwen-Image 2.1 for the cover).

Local song generation delivered as an MP4 with album art: your picture, a Character, or art painted by Qwen-Image 2.1. YuE2 and MiniMax Music 3 write full songs with lyrics from a style and a lyric sheet. A Cover Song card sings your lyrics in your style over the melody of a song you upload, and a Swap Album Art card puts new art on a finished song. YuE2 and SheetSage2 are CC-BY-NC-4.0 (non-commercial); MiniMax Music 3 is Apache-2.0; painted album art is Qwen-Image 2.1 (Qwen Research Licence, non-commercial).

presets.name: YuE2 Song + Album Art
presets.tagline: A full song with lyrics, delivered as an MP4 with its album art
presets.description:
Type a style, add lyrics and get a finished song as an MP4 with album art. SimpliGen has no audio-only output yet, so the song comes as a video: your album art, or art painted for you, held on screen for the whole track.

Subject & Action: the style as short tags, starting with the language: language, voice, genre, instruments, mood, tempo. For example: "English, female vocal, indie pop, warm acoustic guitar, soft drums, 100 bpm, intimate, bright chorus".

Character Dialogue (turn it on): the lyrics, one line per sung line, with section tags on their own lines: [verse] [chorus] [bridge] [outro]. Separate sections with a blank line.

Duration: the longest the song may run. YuE2 often ends the song earlier on its own, and the video always matches the song it actually made.

Reference Image (optional): your album art. A Character works too, which puts your artist on every song. Leave it empty and Qwen-Image 2.1 paints album art from the style. Add a line "[title] Your Song Name" and the art carries it as lettering. The art is centre-cropped to the aspect ratio you pick; 1:1 is the album shape.

To change the picture later, the Swap Album Art card puts new art on a finished song without touching the audio. The Delivery dropdown next to Dialogue does nothing here.

LoRAs: YuE2 style LoRAs work, for example Atomtan Studio's DreamPop and Old School Hip-Hop (huggingface.co/atomtanstudio/lora-library). Import them with base model YuE2 and put the LoRA's trigger word first in the style, for example "sv_dreampop, dream pop, shimmering guitars". LoRAs change the song only, not the painted album art.

Licence: YuE2 is CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial use only. Painted album art comes from Qwen-Image 2.1 under the Qwen Research Licence, also non-commercial.

Model format: int8 ConvRot (YuE2 for the song, Qwen-Image 2.1 for the cover).

requirements.notes: YuE2 3B int8 convrot (Comfy-Org repack, 4.0 GB, checkpoints\) - LICENSE CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial. Settings from the ComfyUI Text to Music (YuE2) blueprint: ABC score in full mode, KSampler dpm_2/sgm_uniform 32 steps cfg 1. Album art: Qwen-Image 2.1 int8 (7.3 GB) + Qwen3-VL 8B int8 encoder (9.4 GB) + VAE, Qwen Research Licence (non-commercial), shared with the Qwen Image 2.1 pack, loaded only when no album art is supplied. Output: MP4 at 1 fps, H.264 + AAC. Needs native YuE2 nodes (engine v0.36.0).

presets.name: YuE2 Cover Song + Album Art
presets.tagline: Your lyrics and style over the melody of a song you upload
presets.description:
Makes a cover of a song you already have: YuE2 keeps the original's melody and sings your lyrics in your style over it. The same tune can become a jazz ballad, a punk track or a lullaby. You get an MP4 with album art.

Pick this to change the arrangement freely. Faithful Cover also keeps the chords, so it stays closer to the original.

Source song: Reference Audio (mp3, wav, m4a) or Reference Video (an mp4; its soundtrack is used). Fill one. A clean recording with a clear lead melody works best.

Subject & Action: the new style as short tags, starting with the language: language, voice, genre, instruments, mood. For example: "English, soulful jazz-pop, expressive male vocal, Rhodes piano, upright bass, brushed drums". Leave the tempo (BPM) out. A cover keeps the source song's tempo, and a different BPM in the style works against it. Describe the feel instead ("relaxed", "driving").

Character Dialogue (turn it on): the lyrics to sing, with [verse] / [chorus] tags in the same order as the source song. To keep the original words, paste them here (Suno shows them on the song page). Leave it off and YuE2 writes new words to the same tune. Only the melody is taken from the source, never its words.

Duration: how much of the source to cover, from the start. SimpliGen trims the source to it. Paste only the lyrics for that part; extra lines get crammed or dropped.

Reference Image (optional): album art. Leave it empty and Qwen-Image 2.1 paints some.

Song title on the art: add a line "[title] Your Song Name" anywhere in either box. It is never sung, and the painted album art carries it as lettering. With no [title] line the art has no text.

SheetSage2 transcribes the source's melody into a score and YuE2 performs it, so transcription mistakes carry into the cover. YuE2 LoRAs work here too. Only cover recordings you have the rights to use.

First use: after the models download, restart SimpliGen once. SheetSage2 goes into a new audio_encoders model folder, and the engine only picks up new folders when it starts.

Licence: YuE2 and SheetSage2 are CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial use only. Painted album art comes from Qwen-Image 2.1 under the Qwen Research Licence, also non-commercial.

Model format: int8 ConvRot (YuE2 for the song, Qwen-Image 2.1 for the cover).

requirements.notes: Official ComfyUI Music Cover (YuE2) template: SheetSage2 bf16 (1.4 GB, audio_encoders\) transcribes the source melody to ABC (melody-only), YuE2 3B int8 sings it in melody mode with the user's style + lyrics, KSampler dpm_2/sgm_uniform 32 steps cfg 1. Source = Reference Audio or Reference Video (soundtrack read by LoadAudio). Album art as the song card. First use needs one app restart after the download: the engine maps a new audio_encoders folder only at start (verified 2026-09-18, app 1.63.1). YuE2 + SheetSage2 CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial.

presets.name: YuE2 Faithful Cover + Album Art
presets.tagline: Keeps the source song's melody AND chords, sung your way
presets.description:
A cover that stays close to the original: YuE2 keeps the source song's melody and its chords, and sings your lyrics in your style over them. The result sounds more like the same song played by a different band. You get an MP4 with album art.

The plain Cover Song card keeps only the tune and lets the arrangement go anywhere. Pick this one to follow the original harmony.

Source song: Reference Audio (mp3, wav, m4a) or Reference Video (an mp4; its soundtrack is used). Fill one. A clean recording with a clear lead melody works best.

Subject & Action: the new style as short tags, starting with the language: language, voice, genre, instruments, mood. Leave the tempo (BPM) out, because the cover keeps the source's tempo.

Character Dialogue (turn it on): the lyrics, with [verse] / [chorus] tags in the same order as the source. Paste the original words to keep them. Leave it off and YuE2 writes new words to the same tune.

Duration: how much of the source to cover, from the start. Paste only the lyrics for that part.

Reference Image (optional): album art. Leave it empty and Qwen-Image 2.1 paints some.

Song title on the art: add a line "[title] Your Song Name" anywhere in either box. It is never sung, and the painted album art carries it as lettering. With no [title] line the art has no text.

SheetSage2 transcribes the source's melody and chords into a score and YuE2 performs it, so transcription mistakes, especially a wrong chord, carry into the cover. YuE2 LoRAs work here too. Only cover recordings you have the rights to use.

First use: after the models download, restart SimpliGen once, because SheetSage2 goes into a new audio_encoders model folder.

Licence: YuE2 and SheetSage2 are CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial use only. Painted album art comes from Qwen-Image 2.1 under the Qwen Research Licence, also non-commercial.

Model format: int8 ConvRot (YuE2 for the song, Qwen-Image 2.1 for the cover).

requirements.notes: Score-conditioned cover with melody AND harmony (the yue2-music skill's 'cot=full' cover): SheetSage2 bf16 transcribes melody + chords (mode full), YuE2 3B int8 performs that score in full mode with the user's style + lyrics, KSampler dpm_2/sgm_uniform 32 steps cfg 1. Same models, source slots, album art and first-use restart as the Cover Song card. YuE2 + SheetSage2 CC-BY-NC-4.0, non-commercial.

presets.name: MiniMax Music 3 Song + Album Art
presets.tagline: A full song from MiniMax Music 3, delivered as an MP4 with its album art
presets.description:
MiniMax Music 3 writes a full song from a style description and your lyrics. You get an MP4 with album art.

Subject & Action: the music, written in English. MiniMax's own format works best: "Global Metadata: lo-fi hip-hop, 78 BPM, D flat major, laid-back and dreamy. Vocal Details: soft female vocal, half-sung. Arrangement: dusty boom-bap drums, Rhodes, vinyl crackle." A longer description helps too: how the song builds section by section, and an "Application Scenarios & Imagery:" line describing a scene. When that line is there, the album art paints it.

Character Dialogue (turn it on): the lyrics, with [Intro] [Verse] [Pre-Chorus] [Chorus] [Post-Chorus] [Bridge] [Instrumental] [Solo] [Outro] tags. For an instrumental, leave it off and also say so in the description: "instrumental, no vocals, lead carried by saxophone".

Duration: a ceiling, not a target (up to 300 seconds, Music 3's limit). The lyrics decide the length and the model ends the song itself.

Reference Image (optional): album art. Leave it empty and Qwen-Image 2.1 paints some.

Song title on the art: add a line "[title] Your Song Name" anywhere in either box. It is never sung, and the painted album art carries it as lettering. With no [title] line the art has no text.

Needs SimpliGen engine 0.37.0 or newer.

Licence: MiniMax Music 3 is Apache-2.0. The painted album art comes from Qwen-Image 2.1, which is under the Qwen Research Licence: non-commercial use only. Supply your own art to stay clear of it.

Model format: int8 ConvRot (Music 3 for the song, Qwen-Image 2.1 for the cover).

requirements.notes: MiniMax Music 3 int8 DiT (2.5 GB) + pruned int8 text encoder (9.2 GB) + DAV (0.2 GB), Comfy-Org repacks, Apache-2.0; official template settings (euler/simple, cfg 1.7, top_k 50, 30 steps). Needs engine 0.37.0 (ComfyUI 0.37.0 fixed the Music 3 noise bug; the fix node of pack 1.0.0 is gone). Album art: Qwen-Image 2.1 (Qwen Research Licence, non-commercial), only when no art is supplied.

presets.name: Swap Album Art
presets.tagline: New album art on a finished song, audio untouched
presets.description:
Puts new album art on a song you already made with a Song + Album Art card. The audio is copied untouched and the new picture is held for the same length. No model loads, so it takes seconds.

Reference Video: the song MP4.

Reference Image: the new album art, centre-cropped to the aspect ratio you pick.

Prompt: leave it empty; this card ignores it. SimpliGen versions before prompt-optional cards still need a word, for example "new art".

requirements.notes: No model. Reads the song MP4's audio, frame count and fps, and writes the same audio under the new picture. Duration is pinned at 360 s because the app trims reference clips to it; the song itself decides the length.
